summary: Five sisters whose father had died asked Moses for their family's share of the Promised Land. Moses asked God, and God said, 'They are right.'

story_reel.narration: As the new generation got ready to enter the Promised Land, each family was going to receive a piece of land. But there was a problem. Usually, the land passed from fathers to sons. A man named Zelophehad had died, and he didn't have any sons. He had five daughters: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah. What would happen to their family's share? The five sisters did something brave. They walked right up to the entrance of the Tabernacle, where Moses, the priest, and all the leaders were gathered. They respectfully explained their problem. 'Why should our father's name disappear from his family just because he had no son? Please give us property along with our father's relatives.' Moses didn't know the answer, so he brought their question to Yahweh. And God said, 'The daughters of Zelophehad are right. Give them their father's land.' God even made it a rule for all of Israel! These sisters spoke up wisely and respectfully, and God was pleased. God cares about fairness, and He gives some people a special gift for speaking up for what's right.

memory_verse.text: Open your mouth for the mute, in the cause of all who are left desolate.

identity_focus.core_truth: Yahweh can give me the gift of speaking up wisely for what's right.
identity_focus.reflection_prompt: The sisters spoke up respectfully when something wasn't fair. When is a time you could speak up for yourself or someone else?
reflection_choices: When someone can't speak for themselves

quiz.question: How many daughters did Zelophehad have?
quiz.explanation: Zelophehad's daughters were Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

quiz.question: What did Moses do when he didn't know the answer?
options: He brought their question to Yahweh
quiz.explanation: Moses brought their cause before Yahweh.

quiz.question: What did God say about the sisters?
quiz.explanation: Yahweh said, 'The daughters of Zelophehad speak right.'

micro_prayer.text: Yahweh, You care about what's fair. Give me courage and wisdom to speak up respectfully for myself and for others. Amen.

companion.message: Those five sisters were so brave! They didn't yell or complain. They asked wisely, and God answered. Your voice matters to Him too.
